title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：sea　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sea 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the fisherman ① crossed the sea that no boatman in the harbour would have counted, and he said the crossing was the whole of the season. The ② sea, meaning the ocean itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; a sea, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sea in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ sea at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sea, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the fisherman said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sea was the whole of the matter, meaning the depth and not the ocean. The ⑥ sea, meaning the depth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; sea, he said, is either something you cross or the only word that means both an ocean and a depth. He said the depth is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ sea had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ sea of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of counting; sea, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sea I remember is the ocean counted in the logbook, which closed in 1962 and is still counted as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ sea, my mother said in 1964, is the only ocean that improves by being counted; every sea, she said, is a depth that has agreed to look like an ocean. She said the depth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 海；海洋（指渔港里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 海；海洋（指那片海本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross the sea 渡这一片海
D. n. 海；海洋（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 海之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的海之事）
F. n. 海；海洋（指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一片）
G. n. 海、深沉（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 深沉（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: crossed the sea that no boatman in the harbour would have counted
The sea, meaning the ocean itself and not the net
the sea at the far pier
the sea was the whole of the matter
the sea had become a line in a logbook
The sea of the whole thing
A sea, my mother said in 1964

answers.why: cross the sea 意为“渡这一片海”，1955 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯清点的一片海做了一遍。
sea 意为“海；海洋”，指那片海本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被清点。
sea 意为“海；海洋”，指渔港里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
sea 意为“海；海洋”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sea 意为“海、深沉”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片深沉就是那件事的全部。
sea 意为“深沉”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片海，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sea 意为“海；海洋”，指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一片，到 1960 年这一片成了航海日志里的一行。
sea 意为“海之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的海之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的清点。
sea 意为“海；海洋”，我记得的是航海日志里清点过的那一片，1962 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一片。
sea 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，海是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的海。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年那位渔人渡了渔港里没有一位船工肯清点的一片海，他说这一遍才是那个汛期的全部。（cross the sea）
那片海，指的是那片海本身而不是小小的渔网，经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被清点。（sea）
那处渔港里每一片海旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。（sea）
最远那座码头那片海，指的是他们留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（sea）
叔叔说这片深沉就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那片海。（sea）
1964 年母亲说，海是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的海。（sea）
answers: In 1955 the fisherman crossed the sea that no boatman in the harbour would have counted, and he said the crossing was the whole of the season.
The sea, meaning the ocean itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book.
Every sea in that harbour had the same short net beside it.
The sea at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the sea was the whole of the matter, meaning the depth and not the ocean.
A sea, my mother said in 1964, is the only ocean that improves by being counted.
